quote: List anything else that changed for either group around week 13.
problem: An assistant working from the data cannot know about other launches, price changes or suspensions. It will return nothing or invent something, and an empty list reads as a clean bill. The guard against a coincident cause (the lesson's own review variant with the suspended publisher) has to come from the learner.
evidence: Principle: events outside the dataset are not recoverable from it. The lesson's review 2 variant 3 turns on exactly such an event.
fix: 'I will list the other changes around week 13 that I know of. You report any break at week 13 in either group's size or mix that is visible in the data.' Checklist: 'Other changes around launch, listed by you; data-visible breaks, reported by the assistant.'
